body:
Review pass 30. Epic 8 in flight; the scale-gate benchmark was 4 minutes cold so I reviewed it before it runs for record.

THE HARNESS IS GOOD - isolated worker process, 4 GiB and 30-minute thresholds, real RSS via .current_rss_bytes(), a genuine neuroim2 volume domain, dense shrinkage_precision metric, explicit exclude_evaluation policy. No complaint there.

THE FIXTURE IS DEGENERATE, filed as bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT (p2). Measured on the exact gate geometry (52x42x25, 24 active slices, 3mm, radius 6.1mm):

  features                                 52416     <- target hit
  supports                                 min 11, median 33, mean 31.2, max 33
  observations 32, design cols 2           -> residual df per run = 30
  partitions 3, exclude_evaluation         -> 1 training run per edge
  total df for Sigma-hat per edge          30

  supports with k > df (30)                83.9%
  supports with k > df/2                   99.9%

So for 84% of searchlights the local sample covariance is singular BEFORE shrinkage. shrinkage_precision(0.2) is not regularizing an estimate, it is supplying one - the metric comes from the shrinkage target, not the data.

Why it matters here specifically: your acceptance opens with "Establish the actual supported regime instead of promising that every local dense metric scales." The timing and memory numbers stay valid as linear-algebra cost, but they would be certified as evidence that brain-scale dense local metrics work, measured where no searchlight has the data to estimate one. It is also precisely the data-starved corner that produced the largest metric bias in your own Epic 7 study - 3 partitions under exclude_evaluation is the minimum possible training set.

Cheap fix, either alone suffices: observations 32 -> 200 (198 df per run), or partitions 3 -> 6 (120 df, df/k ~ 3.6). Raising observations costs simulation time only, not gate runtime, since residual statistics accumulate once per partition. Worth also emitting the realised df-to-support ratio in the gate output so the certified artifact states the regime it measured.

Still open from last pass: bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX - the MC test still shows replications 64L against standard errors pinned at 120, so the variance gate is sitting on 1% headroom.
